The same simple flow whether it’s lunch, a bus for forty people, or a bag of market shopping.

Group transit, minus the phone tag

Booking transport for a crowd usually means twenty calls. FasTitan puts the whole trip — vehicle, driver, route and passenger list — in one booking.

Three vehicle tiers

Executive shuttles for 10–15 passengers, coasters for 30+, and custom charters for big events — priced by distance, duration and capacity, shown upfront.

Passenger manifest upload

Upload your passenger list as a CSV or PDF for headcounts and verification — no more paper lists passed around on the day.

Recurring schedules

Set weekly or daily routes for school runs, staff shuttles and church services once — FasTitan handles the repeats and the billing.

Frequently asked questions

FasTitan is one web app for three everyday services: food delivery from local vendors, group transit for 10 or more passengers, and ErrandMe — personal errands like market shopping, home cleaning and water fetching, run by verified runners.

Browse vendors near you, add items to your cart, and check out with the full price shown upfront. A nearby rider is matched automatically, you track the order live, and you confirm delivery with your 4-digit OTP when the rider arrives.

Trips start at 10 passengers. Pick a tier — 10–15 seat shuttle, 30+ seat coaster, or a custom charter — set your route and date, and upload your passenger manifest (CSV or PDF). It works for one-way trips, round trips and recurring schedules for churches, schools, companies and events.

Your runner must upload photo proof of the completed task — the shopping, the receipt, the cleaned space. Your payment is only released after you confirm with your OTP, so nothing is marked done until you’ve seen the proof.

By card, bank transfer, mobile money or your in-app FasTitan wallet. Every fee is itemised before you pay — no hidden charges added afterwards.

FasTitan is getting ready to launch in its first pilot city, which will be announced soon. Vendors, riders and drivers in the launch area can sign up first — partner onboarding opens ahead of the customer launch.
